data.name: Ayanraj
data.gender_notes: Ayanraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayanraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Ayan (ruler, lord) and Raj (jewel, king). This name evokes images of a powerful and regal leader who is also rich and precious. The name Ayanraj carries the meaning “Jewel ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayanraj usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
